nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROBLEM Robust Visual Acuity $INPUT C ID TIME DOSEQ MDV DV MDL TSTRAT TMIN TMAX DSTRAT DMIN DMAX STRAT STRATF $DATA robust2.dat ignore=C
$SUBROUTINES OTHER=robust5_wfims.f90
$PRED MU_1=LOG(THETA(1)) MU_2=LOG(THETA(2)) MU_3=LOG(THETA(3)) MU_4=LOG(THETA(4)) MU_5=LOG(THETA(5)) MU_6=LOG(THETA(6)) MU_7=LOG(THETA(7)) MU_8=LOG(THETA(8)) MU_9=LOG(THETA(9)) MU_10=LOG(THETA(10)) MU_11=LOG(THETA(11)) MU_12=LOG(THETA(12)) MU_13=LOG(THETA(13)) MU_14=LOG(THETA(14)) MU_15=LOG(THETA(15)) MU_16=LOG(THETA(16)) MU_17=LOG(THETA(17)) MU_18=LOG(THETA(18))
IF(MDV==1) THEN DOSE=DOSEQ ELSE DOSE=DOSE ENDIF
VA01=EXP(MU_1+ETA(1)) KK1=EXP(MU_2+ETA(2)) BETA1=EXP(MU_3+ETA(3)) ALPHAL=EXP(MU_4+ETA(4))
VA02=EXP(MU_5+ETA(5)) KK2=EXP(MU_6+ETA(6)) BETA2=EXP(MU_7+ETA(7)) ALPHALL=EXP(MU_8+ETA(8))
VA03=EXP(MU_9+ETA(9)) KK3=EXP(MU_10+ETA(10)) BETA3=EXP(MU_11+ETA(11)) EMAX=EXP(MU_12+ETA(12)) ED50=EXP(MU_13+ETA(13))
VA04=EXP(MU_14+ETA(14)) KK4=EXP(MU_15+ETA(15)) BETA4=EXP(MU_16+ETA(16)) EMAXS=EXP(MU_17+ETA(17)) ED50S=EXP(MU_18+ETA(18)) GAMM=2.0
DG=DOSE**GAMM VA0=VA01 KK=KK1 BETA=BETA1
IF (MDL==1) VA0=VA01 IF (MDL==1) KK=KK1 IF (MDL==1) BETA=BETA1 IF(MDL==1) EE=ALPHAL*DOSE
IF (MDL==2) VA0=VA02 IF (MDL==2) KK=KK2 IF (MDL==2) BETA=BETA2 IF(MDL==2) EE=ALPHALL*LOG(DOSE+1.0)
IF (MDL==3) VA0=VA03 IF (MDL==3) KK=KK3 IF (MDL==3) BETA=BETA3 IF(MDL==3) EE=EMAX*DOSE/(ED50+DOSE)
IF (MDL==4) VA0=VA04 IF (MDL==4) KK=KK4 IF (MDL==4) BETA=BETA4 IF(MDL==4) EE=EMAXS*DG/(ED50S**GAMM+DG)
IPRED=VA0+(1.0-EXP(-KK*TIME))*(EE-BETA*VA0)
IF(MDL==1) Y=IPRED + EPS(1) IF(MDL==2) Y=IPRED + EPS(2) IF(MDL==3) Y=IPRED + EPS(3) IF(MDL==4) Y=IPRED + EPS(4)
$THETA 55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 0.03 ; ALPHAL]
55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 3.5 ;[ALPHALL]
55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 30.0 ;[EMAX] 150.0 ;[ED50]
55.0 ;[VA0] 0.005 ;[KK] 0.2 ; [BETA] 30.0 ;[EMAXS] 150.0 ;[ED50S]
$OMEGA 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.1 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.122 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.17 0.49 0.07 0.5 1.0 0.17 0.49
$SIGMA 28.0 $SIGMA 28.0 $SIGMA 28.0 $SIGMA 28.0
$DESIGN GROUPSIZE=42 FIMDIAG=1 MAXEVAL=200 PRINT=20 OFVDIMSCALED=1 DESEL=TIME DESELSTRAT=TSTRAT DESELMIN=TMIN DESELMAX=TMAX DESEL=DOSEQ DESELSTRAT=DSTRAT DESELMIN=DMIN DESELMAX=DMAX STRAT=STRAT STRATF=STRATF
$DESIGN GROUPSIZE=42 FIMDIAG=1 MAXEVAL=200 PRINT=20 OFVDIMSCALED=1 DESEL=TIME DESELSTRAT=TSTRAT DESELMIN=TMIN DESELMAX=TMAX DESEL=DOSEQ DESELSTRAT=DSTRAT DESELMIN=DMIN DESELMAX=DMAX STRAT=STRAT STRATF=STRATF
$DESIGN GROUPSIZE=42 FIMDIAG=1 MAXEVAL=200 PRINT=20 OFVDIMSCALED=1 DESEL=TIME DESELSTRAT=TSTRAT DESELMIN=TMIN DESELMAX=TMAX DESEL=DOSEQ DESELSTRAT=DSTRAT DESELMIN=DMIN DESELMAX=DMAX STRAT=STRAT STRATF=STRATF
$DESIGN GROUPSIZE=42 FIMDIAG=1 MAXEVAL=200 PRINT=20 OFVDIMSCALED=1 DESEL=TIME DESELSTRAT=TSTRAT DESELMIN=TMIN DESELMAX=TMAX DESEL=DOSEQ DESELSTRAT=DSTRAT DESELMIN=DMIN DESELMAX=DMAX STRAT=STRAT STRATF=STRATF
$TABLE ID MDL STRATF DOSE TIME TSTRAT TMIN TMAX MDV IPRED NOAPPEND NOPRINT FILE=robust5.tab
